income_distribution=df["Income"].plot(kind="hist",bins=(20),edgecolor=("white"),color="purple")
plt.xlabel("Income")
plt.title("Income Distribution")
plt.show()
In [ ]:
## 1. Business insight(Income Distribution)

•	Most customers fall within the middle-income segment. 
•	A relatively small percentage of high-income net customers contribute significantly to deposits and investments. 
•	Income distribution is uneven, thereby creating potential wealth concentration. 
•	The banks need to provide low-cost financial products for low_income customer. 
•   Strategic focus should therefore balance scalable mass-market services with premium offerings and 
    financial inclusion initiatives to support long-term growth and customer diversification.
In [4]:
transaction_counts = df["Transaction_Type"].value_counts()

plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))

plt.pie(
    transaction_counts,
    labels=transaction_counts.index,
    autopct="%1.1f%%"
)
centre_circle = plt.Circle((0,0), 0.70, fc='white')

fig = plt.gcf()
fig.gca().add_artist(centre_circle)

plt.title("Transaction Type Distribution")

plt.show()
In [ ]:
## 2. Insight 
•	Customers consistently deposit funds into their accounts.
•	Savings and account funding behaviour appear stable
•	High digital banking use shows that customers value speed and convenience in transactions. 
•	Low withdrawal indicates account retention being relatively healthy. 
•   These findings support continued investment in digital financial infrastructure, customer retention strategies and 
    deposit-driven financial products to sustain long-term liquidity growth and operational stability.
In [9]:
avg_sales = df.groupby("City")["Account_Balance"].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
avg_sales.plot(kind="bar")
plt.xlabel("City")
plt.ylabel("Account_Balance")
plt.title("Average Account Balance Per City")
plt.show()
In [ ]:
## 3. Insight
•	Customers in major urban cities maintain significantly higher account balances. 
•	Some cities show low banking penetration and savings activity. 
•	Income disparity affects customer balance behaviour.
•	High-balance cities may represent premium banking opportunities. 
•   Improve regional marketing, local partnerships, and branch or digital reach in weak locations.

plt.figure(figsize=(12,6))
plt.scatter(df["Income"],df["Account_Balance"],alpha=0.6,color="black")
plt.ylabel("Account_Balance")
plt.xlabel("income")
plt.title("Income Vs Account Balance")
plt.show()
In [ ]:
## 4. Insight

•	Higher-income customers generally maintain larger account balances. 
•	Some high-income customers maintain unexpectedly low balances, indicating high spending or debt. 
•	Low-income customers with high balances may represent strong savers. 
•	Income level strongly influences customer liquidity behaviour. 
•   Strategic focus should therefore prioritize premium financial products, customer segmentation and 
    balance-retention initiatives to strengthen long-term financial stability and deposit growth
In [31]:
df["Transaction_Date"] = pd.to_datetime(df["Transaction_Date"])

daily_transactions = df.groupby("Transaction_Date")["Transaction_Amount"].sum()

daily_transactions.plot()

plt.xlabel("Transaction_Date")
plt.ylabel("Transaction_Amount")
plt.title("Transaction Trend")

plt.show()
In [ ]:
## 5. Insight

•	Transaction activity increases steadily over time, indicating growing customer engagement. 
•	Sudden transaction spikes may correspond to salary periods or promotions. 
•	Declining transaction trends may indicate reduced customer activity. 
•   The business should therefore strengthen forecasting, liquidity planning and operational scalability
    to manage peak transaction periods efficiently while maintaining customer satisfaction.

plt.figure(figsize=(10,5))
Top=df.groupby("Customer_ID")["Account_Balance"].sum().nlargest(10)
Top.plot(kind="bar",color="yellow")
plt.ylabel("Account_Balance")
plt.title("Top Customers")
plt.show()
In [ ]:
## 7. Insight

•	A small group of customers contributes a large portion of total transaction value. 
•	Customer concentration risk exists if revenue depends heavily on few clients.
•	Loyal customers significantly improve financial stability. 
•	Strategic focus should therefore prioritize premium customer retention, personalized financial services and broader 
    customer diversification to ensure long-term financial stability.

## 8.Insight

•	Most transaction amounts fall within low-to-medium income ranges. 
•	A few high-value transaction amount dominate transaction volume. 
•	Transaction amounts distribution skewness suggests unequal spending behavior. 
•   Build retention plans for top customers, expand mid-tier customer acquisition, and reduce dependence on a few accounts.

In [6]:
numeric_df = df[["Income","Account_Balance"]].corr()

correlation = numeric_df.corr()

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10,8))
                 
heatmap = ax.imshow(correlation)

ax.set_xticks(range(len(correlation.columns)))
ax.set_yticks(range(len(correlation.columns)))

ax.set_xticklabels(correlation.columns, rotation=90)
ax.set_yticklabels(correlation.columns)

for i in range(len(correlation.columns)):
    for j in range(len(correlation.columns)):

        ax.text(
            j,
            i,
            round(correlation.iloc[i, j], 2),
            ha="center",
            va="center"
        )
            
plt.colorbar(heatmap)

plt.title("Correlation Heatmap")

plt.show()
In [ ]:
## 20. Insight

•	Income negatively correlates with account balance growth. 
•	Spending behavior strongly influences account balance. 
•	Certain variables show weak relationships, indicating independent financial behavior. 
•	Banks should Promote automated saving features, investment products, and balance-building incentives.
